_about: Mechanisms this repository has RETIRED. scripts/check-retired-names.mjs fails the build when a contract, a workflow or an agent definition still names one as an instruction. A paragraph that names one as history passes only when it says so in its own words (retired, no longer, until <year>, used to, never). Add an entry in the same change that retires the mechanism, never later.

retired.name: safe-merge
retired.replacement: the queue-merge workflow: `npm run queue:merge` puts the branch in GitHub's merge queue, and nothing but the queue writes `main`
retired.why: The manual landing procedure merged `main` on a laptop with `--ff-only` and pushed it; the ruleset now refuses every push to `main` that is not the merge queue's, so the procedure cannot run.

retired.name: auto-merge.mjs as the lander
retired.replacement: GitHub's merge queue runs `ci.yml` on the pull request and again on the merge group; a refusal is written on the pull request, and `scripts/land-watch.mjs` is the local watcher
retired.why: The laptop lander integrated, gated and pushed one branch at a time on the owner's machine and stopped when the lid closed. The queue does the same on GitHub's runners.

retired.name: merge-order verdicts as a landing gate
retired.replacement: order is queue order; `node scripts/merge-order.mjs` stays a read-only instrument for which unqueued branches collide with each other
retired.why: The verdict used to decide whether a landing could start and in what order. The queue lands pull requests in the order they were queued and bounces the one that conflicts with what landed.

retired.name: the ordering hold
retired.pattern: held for <branch>|order-blocked|twelve-hour hold|written off with the reason
retired.replacement: nothing holds for another branch: a pull request that conflicts with what landed is marked conflicting and bounced to its own session
retired.why: The laptop lander parked a landing behind an unqueued branch that collided with it and wrote it off after twelve hours. The queue has no order to protect.

retired.name: the laptop lander's flags
retired.replacement: `npm run queue:merge` takes `--unreviewed "<reason>"` and `--why "<reason>"` and nothing about gates; a conflict or a red run is written on the pull request
retired.why: The flags waived a laptop lander's refusal kinds. `add-merge` now names them as ignored.

retired.name: a red main refusing landings
retired.replacement: a red `main` answers itself: `ci.yml` re-runs the failed specs once, quarantines a flake through the queue and reverts a batch that stays red (`docs/VERIFICATION.md`)
retired.why: The laptop lander refused every landing while `main` was red, which stranded green branches for hours.
